claim: The DOJ Epstein Files Transparency Act production includes two FBI "Intake" records under case 50D-NY-3027571 ("EPSTEIN, JEFFREY; CHILD SEX TRAFFICKING") logging tips to the FBI National Threat Operations Center (NTOC). Serial 437 (online tip, July 8, 2020) and Serial 609 (phone call, June 21, 2021) record an anonymous complainant alleging a sex-trafficking ring at a Trump golf course, that Donald Trump "knew and funded underage sex parties," that Ghislaine Maxwell acted as "madam and broker," that the complainant "witnessed Robin Leach strangle a young girl during a sex party" who "is buried behind the 19th hole," awareness of "three separate occasions in which girls were murdered and buried," and a claimed Sinaloa Cartel arrangement trafficking 12-to-14-year-old victims. These are unverified third-party tips: NTOC intake forms record what a caller alleges, stamped "This information is being provided for domain awareness, referral to other agencies or any action deemed appropriate." A separate internal FBI triage email in the same release (the "NTOC Names" summary, August 7, 2025) records the disposition: the complainant "was spoken to and deemed not credible," with "additional research" showing "3 separate incidents involving police which requested mandatory psychiatric evaluations." No released record indicates any corroboration, excavation, or charges; Trump faces no criminal proceeding tied to the allegation. Robin Leach, the television host named, died June 24, 2018.

notes: Group-B record, handled under the 'separate primary fact from attributed conclusion' rule. What is verified: (1) these NTOC intake records exist in our own EFTA corpus (DS9 EFTA01249502 / EFTA01249507; DS10 disposition email EFTA01660651), and (2) the FBI's own triage deemed the complainant not credible, with a documented psychiatric-evaluation history. The murder, burial, Robin-Leach-strangling, and cartel-trafficking allegations are uncorroborated tipster claims carried by a tip the FBI itself flagged as not credible — they get no standalone assertion (Group C in the split). Robin Leach died June 24, 2018. The reel surfaces the allegations without the 'not credible' disposition that sits in the same released document set. The reel's wider editorial frame — that Kash Patel (who testified to the House Judiciary Committee Sept 17, 2025) and Todd Blanche are covering up the files, that JD Vance held Situation Room meetings to shield Trump, that ~20 administration figures are 'listed in the Epstein files,' and that Israel/Russia used the files for blackmail — is the reel's proposition, not adopted here; the DOJ's July 2025 memo conclusion that Epstein kept no client list is itself an attributable claim. PII: the complainant is redacted in the source and kept redacted; victim/witness identities are not reconstructed.
